outgoing.name: Egypt
outgoing.excerpt: Written between 2000– 1786 BC, the Middle Kingdom Egyptian papyrus Berlin 6619 includes a problem, whose solution is a Pythagorean triple.

outgoing.name: Euclid
outgoing.excerpt: Pythagoras, whose dates are commonly given as 569– 475 BC, used algebraic methods to construct Pythagorean triples, according to Proklos's commentary on Euclid.

outgoing.name: Hammurabi
outgoing.excerpt: During the reign of Hammurabi, the Mesopotamian tablet Plimpton 322, written between 1790 and 1750 BC, contains many entries closely related to Pythagorean triples.
